summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine open-market share repurchases of 822,056 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of ~565.9 GBp across multiple venues. The buybacks are part of an existing program announced 16 February 2026, executed through UBS AG London Branch, with shares intended for cancellation. Post-settlement, treasury shares stand at 182,057,726 with 7,973,679,077 issued. No premium, tender offer, or special meeting involved; this is a standard capital return program. Watch for ongoing execution pace and cancellation updates.
